## How it was tested

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (typecheck, unit tests, docs check)
- [ ] `npm run test:integration` / `npm run test:e2e` if drivers, IPC or UI changed
- [ ] Screenshots for UI changes (local or test data only, never real databases)

## Checklist

- [ ] No real hostnames, database names, credentials or AWS account IDs in code, tests or screenshots
- [ ] Docs updated (AGENTS.md repo layout, ARCHITECTURE.md) if modules or IPC channels changed
